Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ لَا يَرْغَبُ فِيْ الْجَزَاءِ
Translation: O Allah, O He who does not desire reward

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ لَا يَنْدَمُ عَلَى الْعَطَاءِ
Translation: And O He who does not regret His giving

Arabic text: وَ يَا مَنْ لَا يُكَافِئُ عَبْدَهُ عَلَى السَّوَاءِ
Translation: And O He who does not recompense His servant with an equivalent

Arabic text: مِنَّتُكَ ابْتِدَا، وَ عَفْوُكَ تَفَضُّلٌ
Translation: Your favor is a beginning and Your pardon is a grace

Arabic text: وَ عُقُوبَتُكَ عَدْلٌ، وَ قَضَاؤُكَ خِيَرَةٌ
Translation: And Your punishment is justice, and Your decree is the best choice

Arabic text: إِنْ أَعْطَيْتَ لَمْ تَشُبْ عَطَاءَكَ بِمَنٍّ
Translation: If You give, You do not taint Your gift with reproach

Arabic text: وَ إِنْ مَنَعْتَ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَنْعُكَ تَعَدِّيًا
Translation: And if You withhold, Your withholding is not transgression

Arabic text: تَشْكُرُ مَنْ شَكَرَكَ وَ أَنْتَ أَلْهَمْتَهُ شُكْرَكَ
Translation: You thank the one who thanks You while You inspired him to thank You

Arabic text: وَ تُكَافِئُ مَنْ حَمِدَكَ وَ أَنْتَ عَلَّمْتَهُ حَمْدَكَ
Translation: And You reward the one who praises You while You taught him to praise You

Arabic text: تَسْتُرُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ فَضَحْتَهُ
Translation: You conceal the one whom, had You willed, You could have exposed

Arabic text: وَ تَجُودُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ مَنَعْتَهُ
Translation: And You are generous to the one whom, had You willed, You could have deprived

Arabic text: وَ كِلَاهُمَا أَهْلٌ مِنْكَ لِلْفَضِيحَةِ وَ الْمَنْعِ
Translation: And both of them are deserving from You of exposure and deprivation

Arabic text: غَيْرَ أَنَّكَ بَنَيْتَ أَفْعَالَكَ عَلَى التَّفَضُّلِ
Translation: Except that You have founded Your actions on graciousness

Arabic text: وَ أَجْرَيْتَ قُدْرَتَكَ عَلَى التَّجَاوُزِ
Translation: And established Your power on forgiveness

Arabic text: وَ تَلَقَّيْتَ مَنْ عَصَاكَ بِالْحِلْمِ
Translation: And You receive those who disobey You with forbearance

Arabic text: وَ أَمْهَلْتَ مَنْ قَصَدَ لِنَفْسِهِ بِالظُّلْمِ
Translation: And You grant respite to those who intend to harm themselves with injustice

Arabic text: تَسْتَنْظِرُهُمْ بِأَنَاتِكَ إِلَى الْإِنَابَةِ، وَ تَتْرُكُ مُعَاجَلَتَهُمْ إِلَى التَّوْبَةِ
Translation: You give them time with Your patience for repentance, and You delay their immediate punishment toward penitence

Arabic text: لِكَيْلَا يَهْلِكَ عَلَيْكَ هَالِكُهُمْ
Translation: So that the perishing among them would not perish by Your decree

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَشْقَى بِنِعْمَتِكَ شَقِيُّهُمْ
Translation: And the wretched would not be wretched by Your favor

Arabic text: إِلَّا عَنْ طُولِ الْإِعْذَارِ إِلَيْهِ
Translation: Except after a prolonged excuse to him

Arabic text: وَ بَعْدَ تَرَادُفِ الْحُجَّةِ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: And after the successive arguments against him

Arabic text: كَرَمًا مِنْ عَفْوِكَ يَا كَرِيمُ
Translation: Out of generosity from Your pardon, O Generous One

Arabic text: وَ عَائِدَةً مِنْ عَطْفِكَ يَا حَلِيمُ
Translation: And as a benefit from Your compassion, O Forbearing One

Arabic text: أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ فَتَحْتَ لِعِبَادِكَ بَابًا
Translation: You are the One who opened for Your servants a door

Arabic text: إِلَى عَفْوِكَ وَ سَمَّيْتَهُ التَّوْبَةَ
Translation: To Your pardon and named it repentance

Arabic text: وَ جَعَلْتَ عَلَى ذٰلِكَ الْبَابِ دَلِيْلًا مِنْ وَحْيِكَ
Translation: And You placed upon that door a guide from Your revelation

Arabic text: لِئَلَّا يَضِلُّوْا عَنْهُ فَقُلْتَ تَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ
Translation: So that they would not stray from it, and You said, blessed is Your name:

Arabic text: تُوبُوْا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحًا عَسَى رَبُّكُمْ
Translation: "Turn to Allah with sincere repentance, perhaps your Lord

Arabic text: أَنْ يُكَفِّرَ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَ يُدْخِلَكُمْ
Translation: Will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you

Arabic text: جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ
Translation: Into gardens beneath which rivers flow

Arabic text: يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِيْ اللَّهُ النَّبِيَّ
Translation: On the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet

Arabic text: وَ الَّذِيْنَ آمَنُوْا مَعَهُ نُوْرُهُمْ يَسْعَى بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَ بِأَيْمَانِهِمْ
Translation: And those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right.

Arabic text: يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَ اغْفِرْ لَنَا
Translation: They will say, 'Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us.

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Translation: Indeed, You are over all things competent.'"

Arabic text: فَمَا عُذْرُ مَنْ أَغْفَلَ دُخُوْلَ ذٰلِكَ الْمَنْزِلِ
Translation: So what is the excuse of one who neglects entering that house

Arabic text: بَعْدَ فَتْحِ الْبَابِ وَ إِقَامَةِ الدَّلِيلِ
Translation: After the door has been opened and the guide established?

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ زِدْتَ فِيْ السَّوْمِ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ لِعِبَادِكَ
Translation: And You are the One who increased the price against Yourself for Your servants

Arabic text: تُرِيدُ رِبْحَهُمْ فِيْ مُتَاجَرَتِهِمْ لَكَ
Translation: Desiring their profit in their commerce with You

Arabic text: وَ فَوْزَهُمْ بِالْوِفَادَةِ عَلَيْكَ وَ الزِّيَادَةِ مِنْكَ
Translation: And their success in approaching You and receiving increase from You

Arabic text: فَقُلْتَ تَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَ تَعَالَيْتَ
Translation: For You said, blessed and exalted is Your name:

Arabic text: مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا
Translation: "Whoever comes with a good deed will have ten times the like thereof

Arabic text: وَ مَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَى إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا
Translation: And whoever comes with an evil deed will not be recompensed except the like thereof"

Arabic text: وَ قُلْتَ مَثَلُ الَّذِيْنَ يُنْفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِيْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ
Translation: And You said: "The example of those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah is like a seed

Arabic text: أَنْبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِيْ كُلِّ سُنْبُلَةٍ مِائَةُ حَبَّةٍ
Translation: Which grows seven spikes; in each spike is a hundred grains

Arabic text: وَ اللَّهُ يُضَاعِفُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ
Translation: And Allah multiplies for whom He wills"

Arabic text: وَ قُلْتَ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا
Translation: And You said: "Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan

Arabic text: فَيُضَاعِفَهُ لَهُ أَضْعَافًا كَثِيرَةً
Translation: So He may multiply it for him many times over"

Arabic text: وَ مَا أَنْزَلْتَ مِنْ نَظَائِرِهِنَّ فِيْ الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ تَضَاعِيفِ الْحَسَنَاتِ
Translation: And what You have revealed of their like in the Quran about the multiplication of good deeds

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ دَلَلْتَهُمْ بِقَوْلِكَ مِنْ غَيْبِكَ وَ تَرْغِيبِكَ
Translation: And You are the One who guided them through Your word from Your unseen and Your encouragement

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ فِيهِ حَظُّهُمْ عَلَى مَا لَوْ سَتَرْتَهُ عَنْهُمْ
Translation: In which is their share, to what, had You concealed it from them

Arabic text: لَمْ تُدْرِكْهُ أَبْصَارُهُمْ وَ لَمْ تَعِهِ أَسْمَاعُهُمْ
Translation: Their eyes would not have perceived it, their ears would not have comprehended it

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ تَلْحَقْهُ أَوْهَامُهُمْ
Translation: And their imaginations would not have reached it

Arabic text: فَقُلْتَ اذْكُرُونِيْ أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَ اشْكُرُوْا لِيْ وَ لَا تَكْفُرُونِ
Translation: So You said: "Remember Me, I will remember you, and be grateful to Me and do not deny Me"

Arabic text: وَ قُلْتَ لَئِنْ شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ
Translation: And You said: "If you are grateful, I will surely increase you

Arabic text: وَ لَئِنْ كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِيْ لَشَدِيدٌ
Translation: But if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe"

Arabic text: وَ قُلْتَ ادْعُونِيْ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ
Translation: And You said: "Call upon Me; I will respond to you

Arabic text: إِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِي
Translation: Indeed, those who disdain My worship

Arabic text: سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ
Translation: Will enter Hell humiliated"

Arabic text: فَسَمَّيْتَ دُعَاءَكَ عِبَادَةً وَ تَرْكَهُ اسْتِكْبَارًا
Translation: So You named calling upon You worship, and its neglect arrogance

Arabic text: وَ تَوَعَّدْتَ عَلَى تَرْكِهِ دُخُولَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ
Translation: And You threatened its neglect with entrance into Hell in humiliation

Arabic text: فَذَكَرُوكَ بِمَنِّكَ وَ شَكَرُوكَ بِفَضْلِكَ
Translation: So they remembered You by Your favor and thanked You by Your grace

Arabic text: وَ دَعَوْكَ بِأَمْرِكَ
Translation: And they called upon You by Your command

Arabic text: وَ تَصَدَّقُوْا لَكَ طَلَبًا لِمَزِيدِكَ
Translation: And they gave charity seeking Your increase

Arabic text: وَ فِيهَا كَانَتْ نَجَاتُهُمْ مِنْ غَضَبِكَ
Translation: And in all this was their salvation from Your wrath

Arabic text: وَ فَوْزُهُمْ بِرِضَاكَ
Translation: And their success through Your pleasure

Arabic text: وَ لَوْ دَلَّ مَخْلُوقٌ مَخْلُوقًا مِنْ نَفْسِهِ
Translation: And if a creature had guided a creature like himself

Arabic text: عَلَى مِثْلِ الَّذِيْ دَلَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عِبَادَكَ مِنْكَ
Translation: To something similar to what You have guided Your servants to from Yourself

Arabic text: كَانَ مَوْصُوفًا بِالْإِحْسَانِ
Translation: He would have been described as benevolent

Arabic text: وَ مَنْعُوتًا بِالْإِمْتِنَانِ وَ مَحْمُودًا بِكُلِّ لِسَانٍ
Translation: And characterized as gracious and praised by every tongue

Arabic text: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ مَا وُجِدَ فِيْ حَمْدِكَ مَذْهَبٌ
Translation: So to You belongs praise as long as there is a way to praise You

Arabic text: وَ مَا بَقِيَ لِلْحَمْدِ لَفْظٌ تُحْمَدُ بِهِ وَ مَعْنًى يَنْصَرِفُ إِلَيْهِ
Translation: And as long as there remains a word with which You are praised and a meaning that refers to it

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ تَحَمَّدَ إِلَى عِبَادِهِ بِالْإِحْسَانِ وَ الْفَضْلِ
Translation: O He who shows kindness to His servants with beneficence and bounty

Arabic text: وَ غَمَرَهُمْ بِالْمَنِّ وَ الطَّوْلِ
Translation: And who overwhelms them with favor and generosity

Arabic text: مَا أَفْشَى فِينَا نِعْمَتَكَ وَ أَسْبَغَ عَلَيْنَا مِنَّتَكَ
Translation: How abundant is Your blessing upon us and how extensive is Your favor toward us

Arabic text: وَ أَخَصَّنَا بِبِرِّكَ
Translation: And how especially have You singled us out with Your goodness

Arabic text: هَدَيْتَنَا لِدِينِكَ الَّذِيْ اصْطَفَيْتَ
Translation: You have guided us to Your religion which You have chosen

Arabic text: وَ مِلَّتِكَ الَّتِيْ ارْتَضَيْتَ
Translation: And Your creed with which You are pleased

Arabic text: وَ سَبِيلِكَ الَّذِيْ سَهَّلْتَ
Translation: And Your path which You have made easy

Arabic text: وَ بَصَّرْتَنَا الزُّلْفَةَ لَدَيْكَ وَ الْوُصُولَ إِلَى كَرَامَتِكَ
Translation: And You have shown us the way to proximity with You and arrival at Your honor

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَ أَنْتَ جَعَلْتَ مِنْ صَفَايَا تِلْكَ الْوَظَائِفِ
Translation: O Allah, You have made from the choicest of those duties

Arabic text: وَ خَصَائِصِ تِلْكَ الْفُرُوضِ
Translation: And the special distinctions of those obligations

Arabic text: شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِيْ اخْتَصَصْتَهُ مِنْ سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ
Translation: The month of Ramadan which You have distinguished from other months

Arabic text: وَ تَخَيَّرْتَهُ مِنْ جَمِيْعِ الْأَزْمِنَةِ وَ الدُّهُورِ
Translation: And selected from all periods and eras

Arabic text: وَ آثَرْتَهُ عَلَى كُلِّ أَوْقَاتِ السَّنَةِ
Translation: And preferred over all times of the year

Arabic text: بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ وَ النُّورِ
Translation: Through what You have revealed in it of the Quran and the light

Arabic text: وَ ضَاعَفْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْإِيمَانِ
Translation: And what You have multiplied in it of faith

Arabic text: وَ فَرَضْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ الصِّيَامِ
Translation: And what You have obligated in it of fasting

Arabic text: وَ رَغَّبْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْقِيَامِ
Translation: And what You have encouraged in it of night prayer

Arabic text: وَ أَجْلَلْتَ فِيهِ مِنْ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ
Translation: And what You have magnified in it of the Night of Decree

Arabic text: اَلَّتِيْ هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
Translation: Which is better than a thousand months

Arabic text: ثُمَّ آثَرْتَنَا بِهِ عَلَى سَائِرِ الْأُمَمِ
Translation: Then You preferred us with it over other nations

Arabic text: وَ اصْطَفَيْتَنَا بِفَضْلِهِ دُوْنَ أَهْلِ الْمِلَلِ
Translation: And You selected us by its virtue over the followers of other religions

Arabic text: فَصُمْنَا بِأَمْرِكَ نَهَارَهُ
Translation: So we fasted by Your command its days

Arabic text: وَ قُمْنَا بِعَوْنِكَ لَيْلَهُ
Translation: And we stood by Your help during its nights

Arabic text: مُتَعَرِّضِينَ بِصِيَامِهِ وَ قِيَامِهِ لِمَا عَرَّضْتَنَا لَهُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: Presenting ourselves through its fasting and its standing for what You have exposed us to from Your mercy

Arabic text: وَ تَسَبَّبْنَا إِلَيْهِ مِنْ مَثُوبَتِكَ
Translation: And seeking a means to what causes Your reward

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ الْمَلِيْءُ بِمَا رُغِبَ فِيْهِ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And You are full of what is desired from You

Arabic text: اَلْجَوَادُ بِمَا سُئِلْتَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
Translation: Generous with what is asked of Your bounty

Arabic text: اَلْقَرِيبُ إِلَى مَنْ حَاوَلَ قُرْبَكَ
Translation: Near to whoever seeks Your closeness

Arabic text: وَ قَدْ أَقَامَ فِينَا هَذَا الشَّهْرُ مَقَامَ حَمْدٍ
Translation: And this month stood among us in a praiseworthy station

Arabic text: وَ صَحِبَنَا صُحْبَةَ مَبْرُورٍ
Translation: And accompanied us with the companionship of one blessed

Arabic text: وَ أَرْبَحَنَا أَفْضَلَ أَرْبَاحِ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
Translation: And it brought us the most excellent profit of all the world

Arabic text: ثُمَّ قَدْ فَارَقَنَا عِنْدَ تَمَامِ وَقْتِهِ وَ انْقِطَاعِ مُدَّتِهِ وَ وَفَاءِ عَدَدِهِ
Translation: Then it has parted from us at the completion of its time, the cutting off of its duration, and the fulfillment of its number

Arabic text: فَنَحْنُ مُوَدِّعُوهُ وِدَاعَ مَنْ عَزَّ فِرَاقُهُ عَلَيْنَا
Translation: So we bid it farewell as one whose departure is grievous to us

Arabic text: وَ غَمَّنَا وَ أَوْحَشَنَا انْصِرَافُهُ عَنَّا
Translation: And whose leaving makes us sad and lonely

Arabic text: وَ لَزِمَنَا لَهُ الذِّمَامُ الْمَحْفُوظُ
Translation: And upon us remains its protected covenant

Arabic text: وَ الْحُرْمَةُ الْمَرْعِيَّةُ وَ الْحَقُّ الْمَقْضِيُّ
Translation: And its preserved sanctity and its fulfilled right

Arabic text: فَنَحْنُ قَائِلُونَ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ
Translation: So we say: Peace be upon you

Arabic text: يَا شَهْرَ اللَّهِ الْأَكْبَرَ وَ يَا عِيدَ أَوْلِيَائِهِ
Translation: O greatest month of Allah and O festival of His friends

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَكْرَمَ مَصْحُوبٍ مِنَ الْأَوْقَاتِ
Translation: Peace be upon you, O most noble of accompanying times

Arabic text: وَ يَا خَيْرَ شَهْرٍ فِيْ الْأَيَّامِ وَ السَّاعَاتِ
Translation: And O best month in days and hours

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْرٍ قَرُبَتْ فِيهِ الْآمَالُ
Translation: Peace be upon you, O month in which hopes drew near

Arabic text: وَ نُشِرَتْ فِيهِ الْأَعْمَالُ
Translation: And good deeds were spread

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ قَرِينٍ جَلَّ قَدْرُهُ مَوْجُودًا
Translation: Peace be upon you, O companion whose worth was magnificent while present

Arabic text: وَ أَفْجَعَ فَقْدُهُ مَفْقُوْدًا وَ مَرْجُوٍّ آلَمَ فِرَاقُهُ
Translation: And whose absence causes grief when missing, and anticipated one whose departure brings pain

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَلِيفٍ آنَسَ مُقْبِلًا فَسَرَّ
Translation: Peace be upon you, O familiar one who came bringing joy

Arabic text: وَ أَوْحَشَ مُنْقَضِيًا فَمَضَّ
Translation: And departed leaving loneliness

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ مُجَاوِرٍ رَقَّتْ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ وَ قَلَّتْ فِيهِ الذُّنُوبُ
Translation: Peace be upon you, O neighbor in whom hearts became tender and sins diminished

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ نَاصِرٍ أَعَانَ عَلَى الشَّيْطَانِ
Translation: Peace be upon you, O helper who aided against Satan

Arabic text: وَ صَاحِبٍ سَهَّلَ سُبُلَ الْإِحْسَانِ
Translation: And O companion who made easy the paths of good

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مَا أَكْثَرَ عُتَقَاءَ اللَّهِ فِيكَ
Translation: Peace be upon you - how numerous are Allah's freedmen in you

Arabic text: وَ مَا أَسْعَدَ مَنْ رَعَى حُرْمَتَكَ بِكَ
Translation: And how happy is he who respected your sanctity through you

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ أَمْحَاكَ لِلذُّنُوبِ
Translation: Peace be upon you - how you erased sins

Arabic text: وَ أَسْتَرَكَ لِأَنْوَاعِ الْعُيُوبِ
Translation: And covered all types of faults

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ أَطْوَلَكَ عَلَى الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ
Translation: Peace be upon you - how long you were for sinners

Arabic text: وَ أَهْيَبَكَ فِيْ صُدُورِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
Translation: And how awesome you were in the hearts of the believers

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْرٍ لَا تُنَافِسُهُ الْأَيَّامُ
Translation: Peace be upon you, O month with which other days cannot compete

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْرٍ هُوَ مِنْ كُلِّ أَمْرٍ سَلَامٌ
Translation: Peace be upon you, O month which is peace in all matters

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ غَيْرَ كَرِيهِ الْمُصَاحَبَةِ
Translation: Peace be upon you, as you are not disliked in companionship

Arabic text: وَ لَا ذَمِيمِ الْمُلَابَسَةِ
Translation: Nor are your blessings criticized

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ كَمَا وَفَدْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِالْبَرَكَاتِ
Translation: Peace be upon you as you have come to us with blessings

Arabic text: وَ غَسَلْتَ عَنَّا دَنَسَ الْخَطِيئَاتِ
Translation: And cleansed us from the stains of sins

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ غَيْرَ مُوَدَّعٍ بَرَمًا
Translation: Peace be upon you - you are not bid farewell in weariness

Arabic text: وَ لَا مَتْرُوكٍ صِيَامُهُ سَأَمًا
Translation: Nor is your fasting left due to boredom

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ مَطْلُوْبٍ قَبْلَ وَقْتِهِ
Translation: Peace be upon you, O sought-after one before your time

Arabic text: وَ مَحْزُونٍ عَلَيْهِ قَبْلَ فَوْتِهِ
Translation: And O one whose passing is grieved before its loss

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ كَمْ مِنْ سُوءٍ صُرِفَ بِكَ عَنَّا
Translation: Peace be upon you - how much evil has been diverted from us through you

Arabic text: وَ كَمْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ أُفِيضَ بِكَ عَلَيْنَا
Translation: And how much good has been poured upon us through you

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ وَ عَلَى لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ
Translation: Peace be upon you and upon the Night of Decree

Arabic text: اَلَّتِيْ هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
Translation: Which is better than a thousand months

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ أَحْرَصَنَا بِالْأَمْسِ عَلَيْكَ
Translation: Peace be upon you - how eager we were yesterday for you

Arabic text: وَ أَشَدَّ شَوْقَنَا غَدًا إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And how intense our longing will be tomorrow for you

Arabic text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ وَ عَلَى فَضْلِكَ الَّذِيْ حُرِمْنَاهُ
Translation: Peace be upon you and upon your bounty which we have been denied

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى مَاضٍ مِنْ بَرَكَاتِكَ سُلِبْنَاهُ
Translation: And upon your past blessings which have been taken from us

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا أَهْلُ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ الَّذِيْ شَرَّفْتَنَا بِهِ
Translation: O Allah, we are the people of this month which You have honored us with

Arabic text: وَ وَفَّقْتَنَا بِمَنِّكَ لَهُ حِيْنَ جَهِلَ الْأَشْقِيَاءُ وَقْتَهُ
Translation: And granted us success through Your favor when the wretched were ignorant of its time

Arabic text: وَ حُرِمُوْا لِشَقَائِهِمْ فَضْلَهُ
Translation: And deprived of its virtue due to their wretchedness

Arabic text: أَنْتَ وَلِيُّ مَا آثَرْتَنَا بِهِ مِنْ مَعْرِفَتِهِ
Translation: You are the guardian of what You have preferred us with of its knowledge

Arabic text: وَ هَدَيْتَنَا لَهُ مِنْ سُنَّتِهِ
Translation: And guided us to of its practice

Arabic text: وَ قَدْ تَوَلَّيْنَا بِتَوْفِيقِكَ صِيَامَهُ وَ قِيَامَهُ عَلَى تَقْصِيرٍ
Translation: And we have undertaken, by Your conciliation, its fasting and its standing, with shortcoming

Arabic text: وَ أَدَّيْنَا فِيهِ قَلِيْلًا مِنْ كَثِيرٍ
Translation: And we have performed in it little out of much

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ إِقْرَارًا بِالْإِسَاءَةِ
Translation: O Allah, so to You belongs praise as an acknowledgment of wrongdoing

Arabic text: وَ اعْتِرَافًا بِالْإِضَاعَةِ وَ لَكَ مِنْ قُلُوبِنَا عَقْدُ النَّدَمِ
Translation: And confession of negligence, and for You from our hearts is the contract of regret

Arabic text: وَ مِنْ أَلْسِنَتِنَا صِدْقُ الِاعْتِذَارِ
Translation: And from our tongues the truthfulness of excuse

Arabic text: فَأْجُرْنَا عَلَى مَا أَصَابَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ التَّفْرِيطِ
Translation: So reward us, despite the neglect that has befallen us in this month

Arabic text: أَجْرًا نَسْتَدْرِكُ بِهِ الْفَضْلَ الْمَرْغُوبَ فِيهِ
Translation: With a reward through which we may reach the desired virtue

Arabic text: وَ نَعْتَاضُ بِهِ مِنْ أَنْوَاعِ الذُّخْرِ الْمَحْرُوصِ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: And we may receive compensation for the types of treasures we coveted

Arabic text: وَ أَوْجِبْ لَنَا عُذْرَكَ عَلَى مَا قَصَّرْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ حَقِّكَ
Translation: And make obligatory for us Your excuse for what we have fallen short in fulfilling Your right

Arabic text: وَ ابْلُغْ بِأَعْمَارِنَا مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيْنَا مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ الْمُقْبِلِ
Translation: And extend our lifespans until the approaching month of Ramadan

Arabic text: فَإِذَا بَلَّغْتَنَاهُ فَأَعِنَّا عَلَى تَنَاوُلِ
Translation: And when You have extended our lives to reach it, then help us to undertake

Arabic text: مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ مِنَ الْعِبَادَةِ
Translation: The worship that You deserve

Arabic text: وَ أَدِّنَا إِلَى الْقِيَامِ بِمَا يَسْتَحِقُّهُ مِنَ الطَّاعَةِ
Translation: And guide us to perform what it requires of obedience

Arabic text: وَ أَجْرِ لَنَا مِنْ صَالِحِ الْعَمَلِ
Translation: And grant us to perform of righteous deeds

Arabic text: مَا يَكُونُ دَرَكًا لِحَقِّكَ فِيْ الشَّهْرَيْنِ مِنْ شُهُورِ الدَّهْرِ
Translation: That which will fulfill Your right in both months of all time

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَ مَا أَلْمَمْنَا بِهِ فِيْ شَهْرِنَا هَذَا مِنْ لَمَمٍ أَوْ إِثْمٍ
Translation: O Allah, whatever minor sins or major sins we have committed in this month

Arabic text: أَوْ وَاقَعْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ ذَنْبٍ وَ اكْتَسَبْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ خَطِيئَةٍ
Translation: Or whatever fault we have fallen into or sin we have earned

Arabic text: عَلَى تَعَمُّدٍ مِنَّا أَوْ عَلَى نِسْيَانٍ ظَلَمْنَا فِيهِ أَنْفُسَنَا أَوِ انْتَهَكْنَا بِهِ حُرْمَةً مِنْ غَيْرِنَا
Translation: Intentionally or forgetfully, wherein we have wronged ourselves or violated the sanctity of others

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اسْتُرْنَا بِسِتْرِكَ
Translation: Then bless Muhammad and his family and cover us with Your covering

Arabic text: وَ اعْفُ عَنَّا بِعَفْوِكَ
Translation: And pardon us with Your pardon

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَنْصِبْنَا فِيهِ لِأَعْيُنِ الشَّامِتِينَ
Translation: And do not expose us in it to the eyes of the gloaters

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَبْسُطْ عَلَيْنَا فِيهِ أَلْسُنَ الطَّاعِنِيْنَ
Translation: And do not stretch out against us in it the tongues of the slanderers

Arabic text: وَ اسْتَعْمِلْنَا بِمَا يَكُونُ حِطَّةً وَ كَفَّارَةً
Translation: And employ us in what will be a reduction and expiation

Arabic text: لِمَا أَنْكَرْتَ مِنَّا فِيهِ بِرَأْفَتِكَ الَّتِيْ لَا تَنْفَدُ
Translation: For what You disapprove from us in it, through Your compassion which does not deplete

Arabic text: وَ فَضْلِكَ الَّذِيْ لَا يَنْقُصُ
Translation: And Your bounty which does not diminish

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ اجْبُرْ مُصِيبَتَنَا بِشَهْرِنَا
Translation: And compensate our loss in our month

Arabic text: وَ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْ يَوْمِ عِيدِنَا وَ فِطْرِنَا
Translation: And bless us in our day of our festival and our breaking fast

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْهُ مِنْ خَيْرِ يَوْمٍ مَرَّ عَلَيْنَا أَجْلَبِهِ لِعَفْوٍ وَ أَمْحَاهُ لِذَنْبٍ
Translation: And make it the best day that has passed over us, most conducive to pardon and most effacing of sin

Arabic text: وَ اغْفِرْ لَنَا مَا خَفِيَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِنَا وَ مَا عَلَنَ
Translation: And forgive us our sins, both hidden and open

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اسْلَخْنَا بِانْسِلَاخِ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ مِنْ خَطَايَانَا
Translation: O Allah, strip us, with the stripping away of this month, of our errors

Arabic text: وَ أَخْرِجْنَا بِخُرُوجِهِ مِنْ سَيِّئَاتِنَا
Translation: And take us out, with its departure, from our misdeeds

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَسْعَدِ أَهْلِهِ بِهِ
Translation: And make us among the most fortunate of its people

Arabic text: وَ أَجْزَلِهِمْ قِسْمًا فِيهِ وَ أَوْفَرِهِمْ حَظًّا مِنْهُ
Translation: And the most abundant of them in portion and the fullest of them in share

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَ مَنْ رَعَى هَذَا الشَّهْرَ حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهِ
Translation: O Allah, whoever observed this month as it ought to be observed

Arabic text: وَ حَفِظَ حُرْمَتَهُ حَقَّ حِفْظِهَا وَ قَامَ بِحُدُودِهِ حَقَّ قِيَامِهَا
Translation: And guarded its sanctity as it ought to be guarded, and observed its limits as they ought to be observed

Arabic text: وَ اتَّقَى ذُنُوبَهُ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهَا أَوْ تَقَرَّبَ إِلَيْكَ بِقُرْبَةٍ
Translation: And avoided sins as they ought to be avoided, or sought nearness to You through a means

Arabic text: أَوْجَبَتْ رِضَاكَ لَهُ وَ عَطَفَتْ رَحْمَتَكَ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: That earned Your pleasure for him and Your mercy turned toward him

Arabic text: فَهَبْ لَنَا مِثْلَهُ مِنْ وُجْدِكَ
Translation: Then grant us the like of it from Your abundance

Arabic text: وَ أَعْطِنَا أَضْعَافَهُ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
Translation: And give us many times its like from Your bounty

Arabic text: فَإِنَّ فَضْلَكَ لَا يَغِيضُ وَ إِنَّ خَزَائِنَكَ لَا تَنْقُصُ بَلْ تَفِيضُ
Translation: For Your bounty does not diminish, and Your treasuries do not decrease but overflow

Arabic text: وَ إِنَّ مَعَادِنَ إِحْسَانِكَ لَا تَفْنَى
Translation: And the mines of Your kindness do not cease

Arabic text: وَ إِنَّ عَطَاءَكَ لِلْعَطَاءُ الْمُهَنَّا
Translation: And surely Your giving is a gift that brings pleasure

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَ اكْتُبْ لَنَا مِثْلَ أُجُورِ مَنْ صَامَهُ
Translation: And write for us the like of the rewards of whoever fasted it

Arabic text: أَوْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ فِيهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
Translation: Or worshipped You in it until the Day of Resurrection

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ فِيْ يَوْمِ فِطْرِنَا
Translation: O Allah, we repent to You in our day of our fast-breaking

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ جَعَلْتَهُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ عِيدًا وَ سُرُورًا
Translation: Which You have made for the believers a festival and a joy

Arabic text: وَ لِأَهْلِ مِلَّتِكَ مَجْمَعًا وَ مُحْتَشَدًا مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْبٍ أَذْنَبْنَاهُ
Translation: And for the people of Your religion a time of assembly and gathering, from every sin we have committed

Arabic text: أَوْ سُوءٍ أَسْلَفْنَاهُ أَوْ خَاطِرِ شَرٍّ أَضْمَرْنَاهُ
Translation: Or evil we have sent ahead, or wicked thought we have conceived

Arabic text: تَوْبَةَ مَنْ لَا يَنْطَوِيْ عَلَى رُجُوعٍ إِلَى ذَنْبٍ
Translation: The repentance of one who does not harbor the thought of returning to sin

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَعُودُ بَعْدَهَا فِيْ خَطِيئَةٍ
Translation: And who will not go back thereafter to offense

Arabic text: تَوْبَةً نَصُوحًا خَلَصَتْ مِنَ الشَّكِّ وَ الِارْتِيَابِ
Translation: An unswerving repentance free from doubt and hesitation

Arabic text: فَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنَّا وَ ارْضَ عَنَّا وَ ثَبِّتْنَا عَلَيْهَا
Translation: So accept it from us and be pleased with us and establish us in it

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا خَوْفَ عِقَابِ الْوَعِيدِ
Translation: O Allah, provide us with fear of the punishment of threat

Arabic text: وَ شَوْقَ ثَوَابِ الْمَوْعُودِ حَتَّى نَجِدَ لَذَّةَ مَا نَدْعُوكَ بِهِ
Translation: And yearning for the reward of promise so that we may find the pleasure of that for which we supplicate You

Arabic text: وَ كَأْبَةَ مَا نَسْتَجِيرُ مِنْهُ
Translation: And the sorrow of that from which we seek refuge in You

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْنَا عِنْدَكَ مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ الَّذِيْنَ أَوْجَبْتَ لَهُمْ مَحَبَّتَكَ
Translation: And make us with You among the repentant for whom You have made Your love obligatory

Arabic text: وَ قَبِلْتَ مِنْهُمْ مُرَاجَعَةَ طَاعَتِكَ يَا أَعْدَلَ الْعَادِلِينَ
Translation: And from whom You have accepted the return to Your obedience, O Most Just of the just

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ تَجَاوَزْ عَنْ آبَائِنَا وَ أُمَّهَاتِنَا وَ أَهْلِ دِينِنَا جَمِيعًا
Translation: O Allah, show forbearance toward our fathers and our mothers and all the people of our religion

Arabic text: مَنْ سَلَفَ مِنْهُمْ وَ مَنْ غَبَرَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
Translation: Those who have gone before and those who will follow until the Day of Resurrection

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّنَا وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad our Prophet and his family

Arabic text: كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى مَلَائِكَتِكَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
Translation: As You have blessed Your angels brought nigh

Arabic text: وَ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: And bless him and his family

Arabic text: كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَنْبِيَائِكَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
Translation: As You have blessed Your prophets sent out

Arabic text: وَ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ
Translation: And bless him and his family as You have blessed Your righteous servants

Arabic text: وَ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
Translation: And better than that, O Lord of the Worlds

Arabic text: صَلَاةً تَبْلُغُنَا بَرَكَتُهَا وَ يَنَالُنَا نَفْعُهَا
Translation: A blessing whose benediction will reach us, whose benefit will attain us

Arabic text: وَ يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا دُعَاؤُنَا
Translation: And through which our supplication will be granted

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ أَكْرَمُ مَنْ رُغِبَ إِلَيْهِ
Translation: Surely You are the most generous of those who are entreated

Arabic text: وَ أَكْفَى مَنْ تُوُكِّلَ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: And the most sufficient of those in whom trust is placed

Arabic text: وَ أَعْطَى مَنْ سُئِلَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ
Translation: And the most bestowing of those from whose bounty is asked

Arabic text: وَ أَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Translation: And You are over all things powerful
